name: discolike
description: Company discovery, enrichment, and contact research with DiscoLike.

interface.longDescription: Prospecting and account research for sales and GTM teams. Search 80M+ business websites to build target account lists and lookalikes of existing customers, enrich companies with firmographics, technology stack, and growth signals, find decision-maker contacts and verified emails, and push results to HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive.
defaultPrompt: Find US cybersecurity companies with 51 to 500 employees.
Enrich this account list with company data and technology stack.
Find VP Sales contacts at these companies.
